sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident semantic image sidecar for Bot's action source image in the bit-and-bot asset pack. Supports character continuity, source-image QA, and action-pose constraint extraction for Bot.
source_truth_note: This sidecar records the committed source image. Descriptive fields are derived from the image itself; canonical visual facts should not be inferred from the filename or other sidecars.
runtime_use_note: Use this sidecar to locate the source image and route it for downstream asset compilation or scene composition. It is not a final compiled asset.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer unseen action frames, additional props, or environment beyond the visible pose. Do not use this sidecar as a prompt or generation contract.

provenance.prompt_unretained_note: Provenance has not been determined for this image.
